plainLang.adoptStake: Half now, half unlocks as the grower keeps logging care through harvest.
plainLang.bondingCurve: An automatic price formula some crypto projects use. growtoo does not use one — growers set their own ask price.
plainLang.collectionAuthority: The operator key that currently updates token metadata and settles Devnet deals. A centralized MVP trust point — see Risks.
plainLang.escrow: A temporary hold: your plant token sits safely with the market until someone invests or you cancel — like a middle shelf, not a permanent transfer.
plainLang.growtoo: Test-network reward tokens with no monetary value. Used to practice investing and stage rewards on Devnet.
plainLang.instantSale: Full price to the grower at purchase. Done — no care lock.
plainLang.plantToken: A digital certificate on Solana’s test network linked to one journal plant. Optional — your journal works without it.
plainLang.redemption: Turning a harvest-stage token into a real harvest share. Coming later — not available on Devnet. Claim locked stake only unlocks escrowed $GROWTOO.
plainLang.rwa: “Real-world asset” token — here it just means a plant token linked to a real journal trail on the test network. Not a stock or cash.
plainLang.settlement: When the deal finishes: payment is confirmed and the plant token moves to the adopter (or returns to you if you cancel).
